market.what: Fe/Al removal step in black-mass hydromet: Ni/Co/Li lost in hydroxide cake + neutralising reagents, world
market.method: est.: 2% of ~$4.0B recovered Ni+Co+Li value lost in cake ($80M; lab losses 4-5%, <1% without Al) + ~$25/t x 600 kt BM reagents/filtration ($15M)

value.logic: cut Ni/Co/Li loss 2% -> 0.5%: 1.5% x $4.0B = $60M + less cake washing/disposal ~$5M
value.revenue_logic: drop-in add-in: $65M x 2.66 (2032) x 10% adoption x 35% capture
value.margin_logic: specialty precipitant/sorbent, competes with phosphate route and Sunresin resins

trend.drivers: black mass growth; EU recovery targets push yield; more Al/Fe from LFP-mixed and pack scrap
trend.deadline: EU Battery Reg: 90% Ni/Co, 50% Li recovery by 31 Dec 2027 (95%/80% by 2031)

competition.paper_query: iron aluminum removal battery leach solution
competition.notes: phosphate precipitation (Aalto) already shows near-zero Ni/Co loss at pH 4; Sunresin sells Fe-removal resin systems for LIB leach

lab.test: neutralisation jar tests on real NMC leach pH 3-5, Ni/Co/Li in cake by ICP-OES, filtration rate; university hydromet lab
lab.logic: synth 6 wk ~$15k (CRO China/India); test 4 wk ~150 ICP x $40-50 + leach ~$3k

sale.gates: plant-liquor bench 3 mo; 6-12 mo plant trial; no product spec change
